title: Input snap and view render use different size sources (viewport px vs DPI-scaled widget px); diff's own debug shows 1.48x divergence
detail: The r2 DPI fix was applied to the view only. Snap math still fits on GetViewportSize while nodes render on the 1.48x-divergent widget geometry; click-vs-node alignment and the visual snap radius are unverified and likely inconsistent.
recommended_fix: Feed the snap path the same DPI-reconciled size the view uses (or convert mouse coords into widget-local space) so one fit drives both render and snap.

title: EndDraw's 'appears THIS frame' refresh is a no-op: view only pulls snapshots when Tick changes, so TopologyGen-only edits are invisible
detail: BuildSnapshot keeps Tick unchanged; the view reads GetSnapshot() only inside the Tick-change gate, so the rebuilt snapshot is never consumed this frame. The two comments in EndDraw contradict each other; the 'instant' claim is false.
recommended_fix: Gate the view on TopologyGen as well as Tick, or notify the view from EndDraw; delete whichever comment describes the behavior that doesn't exist.

title: .uproject enables UE_MCP_Bridge but no Plugins/UE_MCP_Bridge files are committed in the diff
evidence:

+			"Enabled": true

and docs/agent-playbook.md:
+	(the `ue-mcp-deploy` bin is NOT on npm). Deploys
+	`Plugins/UE_MCP_Bridge/` + enables it. Then REBUILD (`--build-only` — the
detail: The playbook documents the bridge as a locally-deployed plugin directory. Enabling it in committed .uproject without committing (or documenting the absence of) the plugin breaks clean checkouts and CI builds with a missing-module error.
recommended_fix: Either commit Plugins/UE_MCP_Bridge or gate the enable behind a local, uncommitted project override; document the dependency in the playbook.

detail: The diff re-blesses save_version 2 and a new state_hash in the probe and SCHEMA.md, yet contains no changes to spine_check.cpp, compare-golden.sh, or docs/goldens/probe-seed42-ticks100.json. If not in another chunk, the contract is broken.

title: Snap radius claimed 'measured in world px' but applied unscaled in screen px
detail: kSnapRadius is compared directly against screen-space squared distance with no division by Fit.Scale, so the effective world-unit radius varies with viewport size, contradicting the documented world-px semantics.
recommended_fix: Divide the radius by Fit.Scale (or document that E4 radius is defined in screen px) and make comment and code agree.

title: DragStartGrid stored and EndGrid computed but never read
detail: After the screen-space snap redesign, the grid-position fields are vestigial: DragStartGrid is written and never read; EndGrid is computed inside EndDraw and immediately discarded.
recommended_fix: Delete DragStartGrid from the header and drop the EndGrid computation (or use them if a future consumer exists).

title: bHasLastEditError written but never read; header claims status-line rejection feedback that doesn't exist
detail: The flag is set on every edit and never consumed; the status line renders only tick/packets/score, so the claimed rejection feedback was never implemented.
recommended_fix: Either surface LastEditError in the view's status line or remove the flag and correct the header comment.

title: Probe JSON 'delivered' is hardcoded to State.Score and 'spawned' to Demand.size(), fudging the schema's semantics
evidence:
+				 ",\"flow_summary\":{\"spawned\":%d,\"delivered\":%d,\"live\":%d,\"score\":%d}}\n"),
...
+			ReachablePairs, TotalHops, static_cast<int32>(State.Flow.Demand.size()), State.Score,
+			static_cast<int32>(State.Flow.Packets.size()), State.Score);
SCHEMA.md:
+| `flow_summary.delivered` | int | packets delivered at the sink |
detail: delivered and score are the same variable, so the golden cannot detect divergence between them; spawned counts seeded demand entries, not fired ones, differing whenever ticks < demand horizon.
recommended_fix: Write delivered from an actual flow-delivered counter and spawned from a fired counter; keep score separate.

title: Shadow alpha disagrees across the diff: header says 12%, code uses 0.14, checklist says 14%
evidence:
PPRunView.h:
+//   Shadow        black @ 12% alpha, soft blob
PPRunView.cpp:
+const FLinearColor kShadowTint(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.14f);	  // soft blob
look-parity-checklist.md:
+| 3 | **Shadows** (soft blob shadows) | ✅ | Oversized low-alpha (14%) rounded blobs offset 2-3px under nodes
detail: Three surfaces in the same diff state two different shadow alphas; the header comment is stale relative to the shipped constant.
recommended_fix: Correct the header comment to 14% (or change the constant if 12% was intended).

title: UObjects created via NewObject in the PlayerController constructor (CDO construction path)
detail: NewObject during CDO construction runs before the class is fully registered and re-runs on every reinstantiation; the safety argument lives only in a comment. Engine reinstancing/cooking edge cases are untested here.
recommended_fix: Create the assets lazily (e.g., in BeginPlay before input setup or via a SubobjectFactory) and null-check in SetupInputComponent as defense.

title: AndroidFileServer plugin disabled with no rationale anywhere in the diff
detail: A slice-1 view/input change silently disables an unrelated shipping plugin; nothing in the diff or docs explains why, and config changes are declared review surface by project convention.
recommended_fix: Remove the hunk or add a comment/PR note explaining the disabling rationale.
